Did you know Purrls is the ONLY tea room in the Valley. Actually the only one for over 200 miles.  Come see what we are all about. @[61573425803052:2048:Purrl’s Tea & Curious]  . Open 930-330 Tuesday to Saturday and Sundays 10-2 for brunch!

Big News from the Lodge! 🥂✨
🎊LODGE IS CLOSED FOR A PRIVATE EVENT🎊

Howdy and good day to y'all! We hope this finds everyone doing well.
We want to let you know that our Lodge, Restaurant, and Bar will be completely closed this Friday, Saturday, and Sunday 
(September 25th – 27th). 

We are thrilled to be hosting a big, beautiful private wedding and giving the happy couple our full attention for their special weekend! 🍾

🎉Thank you all so much for your understanding and support. We will miss you over the weekend, but we look forward to welcoming you back for regular restaurant hours starting Thursday, October 1st!

Our Regular Hours Resume Oct 1st:
🗓️ Thursday: 11:00 AM – 7:00 PM
🗓️ Friday: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM
🗓️ Saturday: 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM
🗓️ Sunday: 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM

We appreciate every single one of you and can't wait to see you again soon. Hope all ya'll have a super awesome great week ahead! 🍻
Vegalodge.com
 970 487-3733

Great news for audiences & actors!

Geek Parties Theater is the house theater for KAFM, and you don't need experience to get on stage. We do Readers Theater performances every second Wednesday, predictable rehearsals & performance dates. Try your hand at acting or direction, get back into it, or enjoy a regular, easy-paced schedule.
